name: save-boot-14b-item-use-plan
description: #135 (acceptance): a planned pad sequence uses an author-chosen restorative item on a party slot below max HP, by pad input only. From harness/saves/disc1-md1stin-potion.json (party Cloud, Barret, Tifa; party slot 1 at HP 300/333; inventory slot 2 = item index 0, quantity 5), open the field menu, Circle on row 0 (Item) and wait until item_screen reads 1 (scr1_wait), then 30 frames. The cursor moves are semantic/planner.js output (generated by runner/test/unit/item-use-scenarios.js): itemList row 0 to 2 (w_list), Circle until item_screen reads 2 (a timeout there shows as w_target 0 after a non-zero w_list), itemTarget row 0 to 1 (w_target), mark, Circle, wait until inventory slot 2 reads quantity 4 (use_wait). Checks: slot 2 count one lower (count_ok); slot 1 HP rose to 333 (hp_ok, and increased since the mark); slot 0 HP and inventory slots 0-1 unchanged; still on the target page in the menu; a rerun matches (match). Only frame counts and 1/0 leave.
